title: calliandra trinervia var. arborea
intro: Calliandra trinervia var. arborea, commonly known as Powder Puff Tree, is a species of flowering plant in the family Fabaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including treating wounds, reducing inflammation, and alleviating respiratory issues due to its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to promote healing, reduce pain and fever, and act as an expectorant to relieve coughs and bronchitis. The bioactive constituents of Powder Puff Tree include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
